0x10251070.name: StChannel_RegisterItem
0x10251070.evidence: logs "Error StChannelItemRegister" when +0x18 is 0; else gets an entry index from 0x1026EF00, sets flag 0x10, Mdl_UpdateEntryFlags(index, 0x200, 1), and sets the entry's weight 1.0 and time from the float argument when it lies in the entry's range
0x10251070.summary: Registers a channel item in the model entry table and starts it at a time.

0x10251200.name: StChannel_ApplyItem
0x10251200.evidence: for an item with flag 0x10, marks its table entry busy (bit 2), runs Chn_ForwardIfFlag2 and, unless told not to, the entry's object callback at +0x18 between 0x102857E0(1)/(0) calls; then clears bit 2
0x10251200.summary: Applies a registered channel item once, guarding against re-entry.
